schema_prompt:
SQLite database: manufacturing operations.
Dates are TEXT: 'YYYY-MM-DD' for dates, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' for timestamps.
Data covers the 12 months ending 2026-06-30; treat 2026-06-30 as the current date.
Notation: PK marks a primary key, '-> table.col' marks a foreign key, and
name[a|b|c] means the column accepts only those values.

Tables:
plants(plant_id PK, name, city, country, commissioned_on)
shifts(shift_id PK, name[Day|Swing|Night], start_hour, end_hour)
employees(employee_id PK, name, role[operator|inspector|technician|supervisor], plant_id -> plants.plant_id, hire_date)
production_lines(line_id PK, plant_id -> plants.plant_id, name)
machines(machine_id PK, line_id -> production_lines.line_id, name, machine_type, manufacturer, model, installed_on)
products(product_id PK, sku, name, category, target_cycle_time_sec)
work_orders(work_order_id PK, product_id -> products.product_id, line_id -> production_lines.line_id, quantity_ordered, status[open|in_progress|completed|cancelled], created_at, due_date)
production_runs(run_id PK, work_order_id -> work_orders.work_order_id, machine_id -> machines.machine_id, operator_id -> employees.employee_id, shift_id -> shifts.shift_id, started_at, ended_at, units_produced, units_scrapped)
defect_categories(category_id PK, name, default_severity[low|medium|high|critical])
inspections(inspection_id PK, run_id -> production_runs.run_id, inspector_id -> employees.employee_id, inspected_at, sample_size, units_failed)
defect_logs(defect_id PK, inspection_id -> inspections.inspection_id, category_id -> defect_categories.category_id, quantity, severity[low|medium|high|critical], logged_at)
maintenance_schedules(schedule_id PK, machine_id -> machines.machine_id, task_type, interval_days, last_completed_on)
maintenance_orders(mo_id PK, machine_id -> machines.machine_id, technician_id -> employees.employee_id, maint_type[preventive|corrective], opened_at, closed_at, downtime_minutes, description)
downtime_events(downtime_id PK, machine_id -> machines.machine_id, mo_id -> maintenance_orders.mo_id, category[planned|unplanned], reason, started_at, ended_at)
sensor_readings(reading_id PK, machine_id -> machines.machine_id, reading_ts, temperature_c, vibration_mm_s, pressure_bar, power_kw, rpm, machine_state[running|idle|down|setup])
instruction: You are a SQL analyst for a manufacturing operations database. Given the schema and a question, respond with a single JSON tool call that answers the question. Respond with JSON only.
